pages.title: Hose Down
pages.creator: Vyew
pages.description: Use your fire hose to fight flames and propel yourself in Hose Down. Spray down to fly across rooftops, then respond to emergencies in districts ranging from city streets to snowy lodges.

pages.title: BirdDuko
pages.creator: Imagine World Studios
pages.description: Deduce where birds sit in BirdDuko. Place one in each color region and each row and column, while keeping them apart even diagonally. Work through boards from four to nine squares wide.

pages.title: Cars vs Zombies
pages.creator: Holystick Games
pages.description: Drive into waves of zombies in Cars vs Zombies. Smash through the arena and gather resources, then upgrade the car or add armor before taking it back into the fight.

pages.title: Tic Tac Toe Merge
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Build stronger pieces in Tic Tac Toe Merge. Combine equal levels and use higher-level pieces to capture weaker ones while you work toward a winning line.

pages.title: Pyramidz
pages.creator: StoreRider
pages.description: Shift entire rows and columns in Pyramidz. Line up three matching hieroglyphs or more and look at how each slide can set up another group.

pages.title: Little Bugs
pages.creator: wavegame
pages.description: Lead beetles down a safe route in Little Bugs. Identify the animal or vegetable from the fragment shown and choose the correct picture so the group avoids the trapdoor.

pages.title: Cosmos 404
pages.creator: LagShock
pages.description: Run around tiny planets in Cosmos 404. Use the arrow keys to evade hostile aliens, collect coins, and take advantage of pickups such as the magnet or speed boost.

pages.title: Jenny's Math Puzzle
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Arrange number tiles to complete equations in Jenny's Math Puzzle. Use what the operation tells you to choose where each number belongs, then move on to another problem.

pages.title: Word Hunt
pages.creator: Shakti
pages.description: Catch letters in Word Hunt to spell the answer to the clue. Read the theme and look for the letters you need before they drop out of reach.

pages.title: Dummies World Cup
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Choose a national team in Dummies World Cup. Control a floppy footballer on a small pitch and try to send the ball into the opposing goal.

pages.title: Brawl Stars Sound
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Press the character buttons in Brawl Stars Sound. Hear each fighter's voice and see the visuals that go with it as you explore the lineup.

pages.title: TimeWarriors
pages.creator: HG POINT
pages.description: Command an army across different eras in TimeWarriors. Lead units into battles that move from the Stone Age to the future and adapt as the armies change.

pages.title: Devil Duck : Not a Troll Game
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Enter the Devil's Domain in Devil Duck : Not a Troll Game. Cross dangerous platforms and make your way past hazards while looking for the stolen treasure.

pages.title: Giant Run 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Choose gates to build a larger crowd in Giant Run 3D. Collect as many runners as you can before merging them into the giant that faces the final challenge.

pages.title: Block Dodger
pages.creator: Vallisubia Studios
pages.description: Split your moving block to avoid collisions in Block Dodger. Check where an obstacle sits and choose the right formation before your block reaches it.

pages.title: Idle Drive: Merge, Upgrade, Drive
pages.creator: GamesdMurdock
pages.description: Tap to earn money in Idle Drive: Merge, Upgrade, Drive. Buy components such as tires and engines, then merge parts to improve the car you're building.

pages.title: Uncle Bullet 007
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Ricochet shots off surfaces in Uncle Bullet 007. Plan the path of each bouncing bullet so you can take out rival agents and get the hostages to safety.

pages.title: Chrome Cars Garage
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Search garages for hidden objects in Chrome Cars Garage. Follow Uncle Joe through your inherited business and look for tools or other items around each workshop.

pages.title: Snow Rider 3D nostalgia
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Steer a sleigh down snowy tracks in Snow Rider 3D nostalgia. Use the left and right controls to avoid obstacles, and press W or up to jump.

pages.title: Submarine Extract Mission
pages.creator: Farkhutdinov
pages.description: Guide a submersible to treasure in Submarine Extract Mission. Watch for mines, thorns, sharks, and currents as you work through the underwater areas.

pages.title: Cowboy vs Skibidi Toilets
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Fight waves of toilets as a Wild West gunslinger in Cowboy vs Skibidi Toilets. Aim and shoot with the mouse, and survive rounds to unlock additional weapons.

pages.title: Summer Floral Prints
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Make floral outfits for five friends in Summer Floral Prints. Choose pieces that use the pattern differently and put together a look for each friend before they head out.

pages.title: Hand Or Money
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Reach for cash and pull back before the blade falls in Hand Or Money. Watch its timing and see how much you can collect without getting caught.

pages.title: What a Leg
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Draw legs for a runner in What a Leg. See how the shape handles the course and redraw it when a different obstacle calls for a new way to move.

pages.title: Bubble Queen Cat
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Shoot bubbles into matching groups in Bubble Queen Cat. Explore caves, break pots, and rescue cats as you make your way through the puzzle stages.

pages.title: Spacewars Invaders
pages.creator: Phillip Santos
pages.description: Fly a fighter through enemy fire in Spacewars Invaders. Dodge shells and bombs and return fire against the machine empire as part of the Skyforce squadron.

pages.title: Fierce Shot
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Take on soccer challenges in Fierce Shot. Work on your finishing as you move through Continental and International Cup matches in a manga-styled career.

pages.title: Golf Pin
pages.creator: Gamebol
pages.description: Work through golf-themed challenges in Golf Pin. Use the mouse and study how the ball can reach its destination before making your move in each layout.

pages.title: Money Rush
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Choose gates that multiply your coins in Money Rush. Compare the numbers as you steer so your collection grows and you finish with as much money as possible.

pages.title: Playtime Horror Monster Ground
pages.creator: Dats Games
pages.description: Hunt as the monster in Playtime Horror Monster Ground. Search the playground for your targets and keep moving through the area as you try to find everyone.

pages.title: Night City Racing
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Race sports cars through the city in Night City Racing. Change the engine setup or appearance of your car and try a different ride across the driving challenges.

pages.title: Master Fall Down
pages.creator: Gamealliz
pages.description: Line up pistol shots in Master Fall Down. Use obstacles to bounce bullets toward enemies that are difficult to hit from your starting angle.

pages.title: Animal Pairs
pages.creator: Gamesonline.co.id
pages.description: Turn over animal tiles in Animal Pairs and find their matches. Remember where each animal was when two pictures differ, then go back to those spots when you find their partners.

pages.title: Firebug 2
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Race across platforms before they burn away in Firebug 2. Run and jump with the arrows, then spend Golden Beans on hats, skins, or tile sets.

pages.title: My Little Army
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Build a team in My Little Army to collect Myth Balls. Mix characters, classes, and weapons and choose which of the three heroes to lead through the missions.

pages.title: Tank Alliance
pages.creator: oneru220
pages.description: Fight through seven armored missions in Tank Alliance. Follow allied tanks, aim at enemies, and watch how damage and destructible scenery change the battlefield.

pages.title: Squidly Game Escape Plan
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Plan a way out for contestants in Squidly Game Escape Plan. Find routes that avoid both guards and cameras, and guide the group past security.

pages.title: Nonogram Picture Cross
pages.creator: Moana Games
pages.description: Read the numbers beside each row and column in Nonogram Picture Cross. Use those clues together to decide which squares to fill and reveal the hidden picture.

pages.title: Word Cube Online
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Rearrange letters to uncover words in Word Cube Online. Use the mouse to work through four modes and build up points by finding the hidden answers.

pages.title: Jump
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Time jumps to clear spikes and walls in Jump. Watch for stars moving up and down and choose when to send the cube through the opening.

pages.title: Circle Rotate
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Rotate a ring with a small gap in Circle Rotate. Line up the opening with the approaching white balls so they can pass through to the center.

pages.title: Imposter Killer
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Sneak up on impostors in Imposter Killer. Swipe to move and avoid being spotted, then spend gold on characters or stronger abilities for later attempts.

pages.title: Rocket Punch 2 Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Guide a flying fist in Rocket Punch 2 Online. Plan a route through the setup and use the hero's reach to strike enemies that would otherwise be out of range.

pages.title: GP Moto Racing 2
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Ride against rivals or the clock in GP Moto Racing 2. Steer with the arrows, brake with space, and use Shift for nitro on a clear stretch.

pages.title: Sweet Candy Land
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Match sweets to complete timed goals in Sweet Candy Land. Check what the current board asks you to collect and look for combinations before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Samurai Flash
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Move a samurai through obstacles and fights in Samurai Flash. Keep advancing through the course, then improve weapons and abilities as you take on later tasks.

pages.title: Future Soldier Multiplayer
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Fight other players in Future Soldier Multiplayer. Use WASD to move, aim with the mouse, and press B to buy weapons for the Deathmatch map.

pages.title: Boho Animals Jigsaw
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Reassemble pictures of forest animals wearing bohemian clothes in Boho Animals Jigsaw. Use the patterns on their outfits and the surrounding scenery to work out which pieces join.

pages.title: Color Roller 3D
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Unroll colors in the right sequence in Color Roller 3D. Compare the layout with the reference picture, then choose which strip to roll out before the next one.

pages.title: Baku The Counterpart
pages.creator: SUCCESS Corporation
pages.description: Draw a route that works for both characters in Baku The Counterpart. Guide each Baku to its own goal while accounting for holes and other obstacles.

pages.title: Troll Face Quest: Video Memes and TV Shows: Part 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Work out the joke behind each scene in Troll Face Quest: Video Memes and TV Shows: Part 2. Experiment with what you click to solve the parody puzzles.

pages.title: GT Jeep Impossible Mega Dangerous Track
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Take a jeep across high, twisting routes in GT Jeep Impossible Mega Dangerous Track. Judge each turn and keep the vehicle lined up as the mountain course narrows.

pages.title: Shoot Paint
pages.creator: ConchGame
pages.description: Fire paint into the slices of a rotating ring in Shoot Paint. Hold to shoot faster when the path is clear, then stop before a moving obstacle blocks your shots.

pages.title: Tank Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Assemble pictures of armored vehicles in Tank Jigsaw. Choose a difficulty, drag pieces into place, and use the game's currency to open other pictures.

pages.title: Arrower
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Send yellow arrows into the yellow box in Arrower. Tap a piece to move it in the direction it points and use special boxes to change where it goes.

pages.title: Virus Bird
pages.creator: YO-YOgames
pages.description: Keep a bird flying in Virus Bird. Click to flap and steer between the virus obstacles, timing each click so the bird stays in a clear part of the sky.

pages.title: Wood Shop
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Shape pieces of wood in Wood Shop. Match the design closely to earn money, then use what you earn to open more shapes to make.

pages.title: Shoot Your Nightmare Double Trouble
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Fight through two nightmares in Shoot Your Nightmare Double Trouble. Explore woods, city streets, and sewers, use the weapons you find, and try the bonus level.

pages.title: Helicopter Want Jet Fuel
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Guide a craft through space in Helicopter Want Jet Fuel. Plan around the fact it only turns right as you avoid planets and electrical or magnetic fields.

pages.title: F15 Eagle Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Slide tiles to restore pictures of a fighter aircraft in F15 Eagle Slide. Choose among three images and three modes, then follow the aircraft's lines across the puzzle.

pages.title: Christmas 2019 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Build holiday scenes in Christmas 2019 Puzzle. Choose from six pictures and set the puzzle to 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces before putting it together.

pages.title: Exit Puzzle : Colors Game
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Guide green dots to their goals in Exit Puzzle : Colors Game. Anticipate how the dots and other shapes turn right when they hit a wall, then time your moves around them.

pages.title: Halloween Truck Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Reassemble a spooky truck in Halloween Truck Jigsaw. Pick a picture and solve it with 25, 49, or 100 pieces, matching the vehicle and its background as you work.

pages.title: Monster Doll Room Decoration
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Give Draculaura's bedroom a makeover in Monster Doll Room Decoration. Choose furnishings and decorations that work together and build a spooky room for the Monster High character.

pages.title: Dracula , Frankenstein & Co
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Defend the monsters from an attacking village in Dracula , Frankenstein & Co. Choose a creature such as Dracula, the mummy, or the werewolf and fight back.

pages.title: Ancient Chinese Match 3
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Match three or more ancient items in Ancient Chinese Match 3. Build a score with each new group and watch the meter on the left so it doesn't drop too far.

pages.title: Halloween Connection
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Connect matching spooky faces in Halloween Connection. Build chains of at least three and check the objective at the bottom before using up the moves allowed for the level.

pages.title: Love Balls Halloween
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Draw lines to bring spooky pairs together in Love Balls Halloween. Shape each line so it nudges the characters toward one another or guides them around what's in the way.

pages.title: Offraod SUV Stunt Jeep Driving 4x4
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Drive a 4x4 in Offraod SUV Stunt Jeep Driving 4x4. Take on stunt routes and judge your speed before jumps and turns so the jeep stays where you want it.

pages.title: EG Super Color Lines
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Arrange jewels in lines of five in EG Super Color Lines. Drag them into useful positions and look for space to build your next match.

pages.title: Tank Stormy
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Use maze walls for cover in Tank Stormy. Fight a friend in two-player mode or hold out against the computer in Survival, collecting bonuses to strengthen your attacks.

pages.title: Blocky Kick 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Swipe to take a free kick in Blocky Kick 2. Work on your aim as the ball moves faster and arrives at harder angles, and try to keep scoring.

pages.title: EG Word Brain
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Link letters to make words in EG Word Brain. Clear the hidden answers, collect coins, and use what you find to work through more puzzles.

pages.title: Racing Game Challenge
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Steer through traffic in Racing Game Challenge. Watch the spacing between cars as the road speeds up, and see how long you can keep driving to improve your score.

pages.title: Blue Casino | Yakpi
pages.creator: YAKPI
pages.description: Turn over playing cards in Blue Casino to find matching pairs. Remember each card position as you play, then return to a card when its match appears.

pages.title: Horizon Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Pilot a ship through hazards in Horizon Online. Roll to avoid obstacles, gather gems as you travel, and use them to buy another ship for future runs.

pages.title: Flood Escape
pages.creator: Enclave Games
pages.description: Build upward in Flood Escape as the water rises. Place the next piece so you can keep gaining height and get far enough above the flood to be rescued.

pages.title: Draw In
pages.creator: Minijuegos.com
pages.description: Estimate a shape's perimeter in Draw In. Make a line long enough to go around it without overshooting, then see the picture that your measurement reveals.

pages.title: My Cute Dog Bathing
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Give a dog a bath in My Cute Dog Bathing. Clean the dog first and choose an outfit for it once the bath is finished.

pages.title: Ado Cars Drifter
pages.creator: AdoLuxGames
pages.description: Slide through corners for points in Ado Cars Drifter. Choose a car and work on longer controlled drifts as you unlock more vehicles, maps, and achievements.

pages.title: Run Astro Run
pages.creator: RedWitchGames
pages.description: Help Astro flee the evil Red in Run Astro Run. Leap between asteroids, steer clear of the hot ones and the comets, and keep moving before Red catches up.

pages.title: Draw and Guess
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Try sketching or identifying a doodle in Draw and Guess. Switch between the two solo modes and see whether you can recognize what a drawing represents.

pages.title: Forest Spot the Difference
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Compare forest images in Forest Spot the Difference. Find five changes to open the next pair, taking as much time as you need to inspect the scene.

pages.title: Twisted Valentine Date
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Get two mermaid princesses ready in Twisted Valentine Date. Browse the styling choices and decide what each princess should wear for her Valentine's outing.

pages.title: BlockUP!
pages.creator: Duchnowski
pages.description: Move your block sideways in BlockUP! to line it up with a block of the same color in the falling row. Clear rows to score and react as the pace rises.

pages.title: Snake Mania
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Collect the coins in Snake Mania to grow your snake. Plan a route through the area so you can reach the remaining coins with a longer body behind you.

pages.title: Daring Dozen Egg
pages.creator: Whopps
pages.description: Launch eggs upward in Daring Dozen Egg. Time each jump toward the next basket and work through the dozen eggs as you try to reach orbit.

pages.title: Dragon Age Rider
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Guide the dragon through maze-like layouts in Dragon Age Rider. Collect the food to reveal the key, then find a route out and pick up coins when you can.

pages.title: Bomb It 6
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Lay bombs and get out of their blast in Bomb It 6. Clear obstacles to open routes and watch where rival bombers move as you work through the arena.

pages.title: Kill time in the office
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Fit personal activities into your day in Kill time in the office. Use the mouse or touchscreen and stop what you're doing when the boss is about to see you.
